description: Full risk card for one Base yield opportunity: 0-100 risk score with the main risks and their evidence, yield sources, sustainable APY, expected return, liquidity, dependencies and recent risk events. Useful before depositing into, recommending or comparing a Base yield. The id comes from the free /api/v1/opportunities. Unknown ids answer 404 and invalid arguments 400 before any payment; 503 while data refreshes; charged only for a 200. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base (x402), charged only for a successful answer. In this MCP server, ids come from search_opportunities.

capital.description: Capital in USD for the expected-return figures (default 10000).

duration.description: Holding period in days for the expected-return figures (default 365).

id.description: Opportunity id, as returned by the free /api/v1/opportunities route.

name: get_opportunity_card
